output.reply: Evidence supports the GPUs and accelerators segment: one report says cloud companies now order accelerators to run models as well as train them, which widens demand beyond training. A second report says one large cloud company is moving more of its AI work onto its own chips, which sharpens the point against and matches the second wrong-if option. The segment and NVDA stay as they are; neither report says how much of the company's revenue each trend touches.

findings.fact: Cloud companies said demand to run AI models, not only to train them, is now a main reason they order accelerators.
One large cloud company said it now runs more of its own AI work on chips it designs itself.

Running models adds a second source of accelerator demand beside training, which supports the segment; custom chips at the largest buyers cut against it. Neither report says how much of Nvidia's revenue each trend touches.
